title: Paige V NDE 8557
content: I was being choked and was losing consciousness. I was sucked backward into a gray tunnel. There was a flash of white light and then I was in the sky. The sky was blue and there were no clouds. I couldn't smell, taste or breathe, and I had no sensation of touch. I felt incredibly peaceful and calm; it was the most wonderful feeling I've ever experienced. Then I heard a disembodied voice that I couldn't see who it belonged to. It said, 'Not yet.' I woke up in my body unable to physically see for awhile until I literally drank in oxygen. It took me a while to regain my sight as everything was gray and foggy for awhile. Next came my hearing senses and after that my sense of touch. Background Information: Gender: Female Date NDE Occurred: 2000 NDE Elements: At the time of your experience, was there an associated life-threatening event? No. Criminal attack. Life threatening event, but not clinical death How do you consider the content of your experience? Entirely pleasant Did you feel separated from your body? Yes. I clearly left my body and existed outside it How did your highest level of consciousness and alertness during the experience compare to your normal everyday consciousness and alertness? More consciousness and alertness than normal. I knew that I was going to be happy in that place. There was nothing in this life that mattered and I felt happy being there. I was disappointed when I came back to this body. I do not fear death. At what time during the experience were you at your highest level of consciousness and alertness? When I was floating the sky and felt supremely peaceful. Were your thoughts speeded up? No Did time seem to speed up or slow down? Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning. Time didn't matter anymore Were your senses More vivid than usual? No Please compare your vision during the experience to your everyday vision that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. I could see very clearly as I was floated up into the sky. I could not see my body or the man choking me. When I was told 'not yet' everything was very gray until I regained my bodily senses. Please compare your hearing during the experience to your everyday hearing that you had immediately prior to the time of the experience. The voice was telepathic and disembodied. Did you seem to be aware of things going on elsewhere, as if by ESP? No Did you pass into or through a tunnel? Yes When I left my body it was through a gray tunnel that closed into a vignette [a picture that shades off gradually into the surrounding paper] leading into a bright light. I found myself floating in the sky. Did you see any beings in your experience? No Did you encounter or become aware of any deceased (or alive) beings? No Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a brilliant light? An unusually bright light Did you see an unearthly light? No Did you seem to enter some other, unearthly world? No What emotions did you feel during the experience? Happy Did you have a feeling of peace or pleasantness? Incredible peace or pleasantness Did you have a feeling of joy? Incredible joy Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity with the universe? I felt united or one with the world Did you suddenly seem to understand everything? No Did scenes from your past come back to you? No Did scenes from the future come to you? No Did you come to a border or point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion: What was your religion prior to your experience? Other or several faiths Have your religious practices changed since your experience? No What is your religion now? Other or several faiths Did your experience include features consistent with your earthly beliefs? Content that was entirely not consistent with the beliefs you had at the time of your experience. I thought that when someone died that there wouldn't be anything after this life. Did you have a change in your values and beliefs because of your experience? No Did you seem to encounter a mystical being or presence, or hear an unidentifiable voice? I heard a voice I could not identify. The voice told me 'not yet' before I was thrust back into this body. Did you see deceased or religious spirits? No Did you encounter or become aware of any beings who previously lived on earth who are described by name in religions (for example: Jesus, Muhammad, Buddha, etc.)? No During your experience, did you gain information about premortal existence? No During your experience, did you gain information about universal connection or oneness? No During your experience, did you gain information about the existence of God? No Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion: During your experience, did you gain special knowledge or information about your purpose? No During your experience, did you gain information about the meaning of life? No During your experience, did you gain information about an afterlife? An afterlife definitely exists No Did you gain information about how to live our lives? No During your experience, did you gain information about life's difficulties, challenges and hardships? No During your experience, did you gain information about love? Yes I felt entirely at peace, that nothing in this life mattered at all. There was no feeling other than Happiness, serenity, and peace What life changes occurred in your life after your experience? Slight changes in my life Have your relationships changed specifically because of your experience? No After the NDE: Was the experience difficult to express in words? No How accurately do you remember the experience in comparison to other life events that occurred around the time of the experience? I remember the experience as accurately as other life events that occurred around the time of the experience. I was being physically abused a lot and had to maintain high vigilance. Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or other special gifts after your experience that you did not have before the experience? Yes I have dreams that inspire deja vu, places I haven't been yet. I could sense when my mother died and I could sense the presence of a very beloved pet when they died. Sometimes when I have a very distinct feeling that something bad will happen it does. Have you ever shared this experience with others? Yes Did you have any knowledge of near death experience (NDE) prior to your experience? No What did you believe about the reality of your experience shortly (days to weeks) after it happened? Experience was definitely real What do you believe about the reality of your experience now? Experience was definitely real At any time in your life, has anything ever reproduced any part of the experience? Yes I have been in quite a few accidents but have not been back to that place. So I know when I'm going to survive. I do not intend on coming back the next time I'm in this place.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Said she was "in the sky" / "floating in the sky" and "could not see my body or the man choking me."

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Described as a "gray tunnel" that "closed into a vignette... leading into a bright light."
tunnel.movement_other_detail: She said she was "sucked backward" into the tunnel.

arrival.other_being_detail: Heard a disembodied/telepathic voice she could not identify, saying: "Not yet."

environment.environment_other_detail: Blue sky with no clouds; flash/bright white light.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: She was "thrust back into this body" after the voice said "Not yet."

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Criminal attack; being choked and losing consciousness.

person_demographics.religious_affiliation_detail: Other or several faiths (before and after).

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE/separation → gray tunnel → flash/bright white light → floating in blue sky → barrier/"Not yet" → thrust back into body with gradual return of senses.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported being unable to smell, taste, breathe, or feel touch while floating in the sky; return involved sequential restoration of senses (vision gray/foggy first, then hearing, then touch) and "literally drank in oxygen."
unique_elements.notable_quotes: "Not yet."; "I was sucked backward into a gray tunnel."; "I felt incredibly peaceful and calm; it was the most wonderful feeling I've ever experienced."; "I woke up in my body unable to physically see for awhile until I literally drank in oxygen."
